summary: The hazard dimension in the web app and the national map in Floods. Fires | Floods switch in the overview title slot (Public, Command, Forensic entry page, phones); workspace hazard with ?hazard=flood; a flood store (lists, open flood with the rule-13 detail chain, alias URL replace, 404 FLOOD_NOT_LISTED / 503 FLOOD_LISTS_503, one event at a time, one history entry per hazard switch); selectors (noEventOpen, openEventKind, currentArea); five map chromes with stub flood chromes; flood framing (frameFlood); flood markers, groups ('N FLOODS'), gauge category diamonds, leader labels ('MAJOR · 24.1 FT'), DEMO tags, hover and clicks (Public and Command open the flood view, groups zoom in) through a mounted flood map module; bar status (never 0 when unknown, watches hidden count), the 'Floods in the lower 48' list (OFFICIAL NOW block, Active / 2026 / 2025 tabs, Show watches switch, outage notices, WATCHES_HIDDEN, FLOOD_LIST_ABSENCE), flood legend, flood point card (every NWS product at the point incl. watches, nearest gauge within 25 km, nearest floods; absence lines only for available answers) and the Fires-mode flood line, flood name search, flood credits, no fire weather or fire data requests in flood mode (fetch-spy test), flood tokens with a no-green test, floodCopy.ts with every PLAN-5 section 5 string and the word-bounded wording guard, web fixtures copied from the backend with edge cases, shot.mjs --reduced-motion.
milestones: M2 fixtures, store tests, no fire data in flood mode, fetch-spy test (f912ad4)
M3 map module, list, legend, point card, search, Forensic entry, screenshots (cbf8338)
review fixes WFO-R1..R13 (12 fixed, R9 skipped: not this role's file); see reports/review5-web-flood-overview.json
screenshot_notes: Flood screenshots use backend/scripts/serve_fixture.py (fixture-flood and the seven synthetic list-only floods, all DEMO). The fire regression (public-fires, 1440x1144 like brief4-final-public-overview-minimal) uses the real API with FIRE3D_LIVE=0 and today's live fire lists: only the title slot (the switch) differs from brief 4; the marker data is today's. A real-data flood overview was also checked (43 live floods from the backend's in-progress M4 list, groups and leaders render) but not saved. Review fixes: missing-flood (/?flood=<dead id>), gauges-down (national gauge route answering 404, as the real API does today) and year-archive-down (the 2026 list with iem_archive unavailable, as the real API answers) were taken on the fixture server with Playwright route interception; point-card and point-card-nearest show the gauge reading time, attribution and link, and the distance note. The real API's 2026 tab was checked too (FLOOD LIST UNAVAILABLE, the backend's reason verbatim).
gates: web: typecheck OK, lint 55 warnings (all src/scene, none added), vitest 113 files / 1469 passed / 2 skipped (pre-existing skips, no flood test skipped), build OK; backend: uv run pytest -q 1227 passed (no network).
known_issues: PublicFloodChrome.tsx and CommandFloodChrome.tsx are stubs (bar, product card, fixed copy, credits); web-flood-public and web-flood-command replace them.
A flood open in Forensic still shows the entry page (switch + flood list) until web-flood-forensic mounts its branch in ForensicWorkspace.tsx.
useZoneSource() reports an open flood's zone as 'place' (lib/time.ts zoneLine has no 'flood' wording; not this role's file); useEventZoneSource() has 'flood'.
The fetch-spy test runs effects once after a server render (no DOM in the test environment): it covers mount-time requests, not later intervals or clicks.
Leader labels can still overlap the selected point's own map label for a moment (pre-existing leader layout behaviour, same as fires).
Search: only an exact (or the only matching) flood name opens a flood; partial flood matches are not listed in the results popover (the place search runs instead).
The overview readout (location/CoordinateStrip.tsx, not this role's) still reads 'No fire open' in Floods (review WFO-R9, handed to the integration).

National gauges: /api/official/river-gauges?scope=national answers 404 on the real API today (bundle-api M3); the map falls back to the listed floods' member gauges and now says so in the legend, the list foot and the Layers panel (WFO-R8).
cut_line_left: Flood search hits are not listed in the search results popover (an exact or unique flood name opens it; river names match through the same function).
The phone layout of the flood list panel is the fire panel's (no flood-specific phone layout).
notes_for_others: See docs/redesign/contract5/web-flood-overview.md 'Notes for the next roles'. Additive store keys: resolvedFrom, detailLoading, detailError. floodController.hit() returns FloodHit {kind,id,lngLat?} and adds zoomToGroup/hoverLines. Flood evacuations land in useExtrasRuntime().evac with hazard=flood (incident_id null: do not filter with forIncident). Wording guard helpers for rendered scans: floodWordingProblems, stripVerbatim, collectStrings in ui/shell/floodCopy.ts. Review fixes: web-flood-public must keep useMapTint('flood') in the Public flood chrome (the stub calls it); the integration should make location/CoordinateStrip.tsx say 'No flood open' when hazard is 'flood' (WFO-R9). New small store map/floodGaugeStatus.ts (useNationalGauges) says whether the national gauge layer could be read. history.ts: fromOverview is true only when no event at all was open before the push; navigationUrl(href, incident, floodOpen) and linkWithBothUrl(href).
